name: glob
title: Glob
description: Wildcard file-path lookup under a known directory; directories never match. No preliminary listing. Unknown base: find first with a known path fragment.

pattern.description: Union of patterns. Relative patterns share path; an absolute pattern uses its own base. Use separate calls for per-pattern results.

path.description: Known existing base directory; omit for the current Project.

sort.description: mtime default (newest first); natural = path order.

limit.description: Max entries; default 100; 0 requests all matches up to the built-in match and output caps.
